# Airwallex Dev

Skills that teach agents to work with Airwallex Dev. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [airwallex/airwallex-marketplace](https://github.com/airwallex/airwallex-marketplace), at commit `8775510`.

Airwallex integration skills for Claude.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Airwallex Dev**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Airwallex Dev**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install airwallex-dev@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

6 skills: `airwallex-ai-provider-card-mit`, `airwallex-billing-checkout`, `airwallex-dropin`, `airwallex-hpp`, `airwallex-kyc`, `airwallex-split-card`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `ACCESS_TOKEN`, `WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `AIRWALLEX_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.
